answer: Make every identity lock an escalating stake: 10 POA in epoch one, doubling each consecutive epoch to a 320 POA cap, with a 30-epoch unlock delay. New identities sit at tier 0 and must pass 3 peer-review rounds for full rewards, queued like ships outside a harbor. Each extra fake identity locks fresh, non-reusable capital, so attacker cost grows linearly per head while honest users amortize one stake; even a nebula of sockpuppets bleeds out. Locks verify on-ledger every epoch and key-reuse triggers automatic slashing, published as a record as rigid as a sonnet's fourteen lines.
